response.query: Which LATE/IV assumptions (monotonicity, exclusion) will be pre-registered, what instrument-strength thresholds and falsification tests will we require, and which weak-IV robust estimators will be used if thresholds fail?
response.answer: Pre-register monotonicity and exclusion assumptions; require instrument-strength thresholds above 0.1 and falsification tests; use weak-IV robust estimators if thresholds fail.
